reason.CQF_buffering_delay_explanation: In CQF, frames may wait up to one cycle duration at the first switch. Worst case: frame arrives just after queue closes, waits full cycle.

The worst-case delay includes transmission time at each hop, switching delays, propagation delays, synchronization errors, and the CQF buffering delay (one cycle duration per hop).
reason.WCD_equation: WCD = sum_over_hops(T_trans + T_prop + T_switch + T_sync + T_CQF_buffer) where T_CQF_buffer = cycle_duration for each hop, T_trans = (payload + overhead) * 8 / bandwidth

CQF_mechanism_details.description: CQF uses two queues that alternate roles every cycle. A frame arriving in cycle N is buffered and transmitted in cycle N+1. At each switch hop, frames experience one full cycle of buffering delay.
CQF_mechanism_details.queue_alternation: Q6 (even cycle) and Q7 (odd cycle) alternate every 50µs

reason.WCD_equation: WCD = offset + sum(transmission_delay_per_hop) + sum(propagation_delay_per_link) + sum(switching_delay_per_switch) + CQF_buffering_delay + sync_error_accumulation
reason.CQF_buffering_explanation: In CQF, worst-case buffering occurs when a frame arrives just after its queue's transmission window closes, requiring it to wait until the next cycle. Maximum buffering per hop = cycle_duration. For H hops, worst-case CQF delay = (H-1) * cycle_duration.
reason.transmission_delay_calculation: T_tx = (frame_size_bits) / (bandwidth_bps) where frame_size = payload + headers (Ethernet: 38 bytes overhead including preamble, IFG, headers, FCS)

all_parameters_used.cqf_queue_delay: worst-case one full cycle at each hop

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = offset + transmission_time + (num_hops - 1) × (propagation + switching + cycle) + propagation + time_sync_error
WCD_calculation.explanation: For CQF with cut-through: at each switch, frame may wait up to one cycle for queue flip. With 4 hops (3 switches), worst case includes 3 cycle waits. Base delay = 3×(prop+switch) + final_prop + sync = 3×2 + 1 + 1 = 8 µs. However, CQF queue alternation can add up to C/2 per hop in average, but worst-case is full cycle wait at first hop if arriving just after queue flip.
WCD_calculation.detailed_calculation: Base_delay = 3×2 + 1 + 1 = 8 µs. CQF worst-case: arriving at switch just after its transmission queue closes, must wait full cycle (50 µs) at first switch, then propagates through remaining hops with minimal additional queuing if synchronized. Conservative: (num_switches) × cycle/2 = 3 × 25 = 75 µs would be too high. Standard CQF WCD = base_delays + (num_switches - 1) × C = 8 + 2×50 = 108 µs is overly conservative. Practical CQF with proper offset: WCD ≈ transmission + (hops-1)×(prop+switch) + prop + sync + C/2 = 0 + 6 + 1 + 1 + 25 = 33 µs. Adjusting for 4 hops: 8 + 30 = 38 µs

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = (num_hops - 1) × (prop + switch) + prop + sync + adjustment

global_parameters.cqf_mechanism: IEEE 802.1Qch with 2 queues (Q6/Q7) alternating every cycle
global_parameters.offset_policy: All flows start at offset 0 at source
global_parameters.wcd_formula: WCD = offset + transmission_time + sum_over_hops(propagation + switching + queuing_delay) + time_sync_error
global_parameters.queuing_delay_model: CQF worst-case: frame arrives just after queue closes, waits up to one cycle. Approximated as (num_switches - 1) × C/2 + C/3 for practical scheduling

all_parameters_used.queue_assignment: Alternating between queue 7 (odd cycle) and queue 6 (even cycle)
all_parameters_used.headers: 38 bytes (Ethernet preamble 8B + header 14B + VLAN 4B + CRC 4B + IFG 12B - preamble 4B)
all_parameters_used.worst_case_queueing: One full cycle duration at each hop

general.WCD_detailed: For each hop: transmission_time = (payload + 38) * 8 / 100Mbps; queueing_delay = cycle_duration (worst case); Per-hop delay = transmission + propagation + switching + queueing; Total WCD = sum of all hops + time_sync_error

components.T_sw: Switching delay per hop (1 µs per hop)


hypercycle_calculation.method: LCM of all flow periods and cycle duration
hypercycle_calculation.note: For WCD calculation with CQF, the relevant cycle is the base cycle duration (50µs), not the hypercycle

cqf_mechanism.queue_assignment: Two queues alternate per cycle: queue 7 (odd) and queue 6 (even)
cqf_mechanism.queue_switching: At each cycle boundary, transmission queue switches
cqf_mechanism.buffer_delay: Frames may wait up to one full cycle duration in worst case

frame_size_calculation.components: Preamble(8) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + Payload + CRC(4) + IFG(8)

wcd_equation.formula: WCD = offset + Σ(transmission_delay_i + propagation_delay_i + switching_delay_i + sync_error_i + CQF_buffer_delay_i) for all hops
wcd_equation.simplified: WCD = 0 + hop_count × (cycle_duration + propagation_delay + switching_delay + sync_error) + Σ(transmission_delay_i)
wcd_equation.note: Transmission delay varies per link based on frame size

all_parameters_used.cqf_buffer_delay: 50 µs per switch hop (worst case), 0 µs at final destination

cqf_parameters.description: CQF uses two queues (Q6 and Q7) that alternate every cycle. Frames arriving in cycle N are buffered in one queue and transmitted in cycle N+1.
cqf_parameters.buffering_model: Frames are held for one cycle duration before transmission

wcd_equation.formula: WCD = offset + sum_over_hops(propagation_delay + switching_delay + transmission_delay + cycle_duration) + time_sync_error
wcd_equation.detailed_formula: WCD = 0 + (hop_count × propagation_delay) + ((hop_count - 1) × switching_delay) + (hop_count × transmission_delay) + ((hop_count - 1) × cycle_duration) + time_sync_error
wcd_equation.explanation: In CQF, each switch introduces one cycle delay for queue buffering. Transmission delay = (frame_size_bits / bandwidth). Frame size = payload + headers (Ethernet: 38 bytes overhead including preamble, IFG, headers, FCS).

general.WCD_formula_detailed: WCD = H × (prop_delay + switch_delay) + transmission_delay_total + cycle_duration + sync_error

assumptions.cut_through: Switches forward frames after reading header only, switching delay is constant 1 µs

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = T_tx + (H-1) * T_prop + (H-1) * T_sw + H * T_sync + CQF_buffering_delay

where.T_tx: Transmission time of frame at source
where.H: Number of hops (3 for all flows)
